test_cases.name: Verbose initial quote request for multiple catalog items
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed context and explanations. The initial turn establishes the business context and requested items, setting up for a later follow-up to update the quote.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Multiple Items
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out from Danish Pastry to request a sales quote for a selection of items we are considering for our upcoming seasonal inventory refresh. We are looking to evaluate pricing and availability before finalizing our purchase order, so please include any relevant details regarding lead times or bulk pricing if available.

Here are the items we would like quoted:

1. Rasta Coffee Beans – This is a staple for our café section, and we are interested in pricing for a standard order quantity.
2. Rug (Item No: AITEM-0030) – We are considering this for our lounge area, so please include any information about available sizes or color options if applicable.
3. SmartToys Building Blocks – We are expanding our kids’ play section and would like to know the unit price and any volume discounts.
4. Generic Jeans – We are trialing these in our retail section, so please quote for a typical retail pack.

If you require any additional information to prepare the quote, please let me know. We look forward to your response and appreciate your assistance.

Best regards,
Anders Nielsen

test_cases.name: Verbose initial quote request for multiple items
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer requests a quote for several items, providing detailed context and explanations. The initial email establishes the business context and requests specific catalog items, setting up for a later follow-up to update the quote.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – FreshHelloFoods Product Inquiry
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Mr. Fresh Foods, and I am reaching out on behalf of FreshHelloFoods to request a formal sales quote for several products we are considering for our upcoming seasonal promotion. We are particularly interested in sourcing high-quality produce and select toys for our retail stores, and would appreciate your assistance in providing pricing and availability information.

Could you please provide a quote for the following items:

1. Organic Carrot – We are looking for fresh, organic carrots suitable for retail packaging.
2. Watermelon – Please include details on size and origin if possible.
3. JoySprout Toy Bicycle – This item caught our attention for our children’s section.
4. Rasta Coffee Beans – We are exploring new coffee options for our café area.

If you require any additional information or clarification regarding the items listed above, please let me know. We are aiming to finalize our selections soon, so your prompt response would be greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Mr. Fresh Foods

If you need any more info from our side, just let me know. Looking forward to your quote!

Best regards,
Playlandia

test_cases.name: Verbose, Impatient Initial Quote Request for Toys and Apparel
test_cases.description: Emily Parker, a verbose and impatient customer, sends a detailed email requesting a quote for several items from the catalog. She provides extra context and explanations, but her tone is curt and slightly rude, reflecting impatience. The email establishes the initial quote context for later update requests.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote – Multiple Items (Please Respond Quickly)
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I need a quote ASAP for the following items. Please don't waste time with unnecessary formalities or delays, as I have other things to do and this process is already taking longer than it should. I expect clear pricing and availability details, not vague responses.

Requested items:
- WonderWagon Pull-Along Train
- GiggleGear Action Figures Set (I need to know if this includes all figures or just a subset, so specify that in your reply)
- Generic Golden T-Shirt (I want to see the price for this, and if there are any color options, mention them, but just quote the standard one for now)
- SmartToys Building Blocks

I am not interested in any upselling or extra recommendations. Just quote exactly what I listed above, and make sure you include all relevant charges and lead times. If you need any more information, ask, but don't drag this out.

Emily Parker

Best regards,
Emily Parker
